Method of Attack: Using boobytrapped image files with double extensions to hide malicious code that forcibly downloads and installs Locky ransomware
Attack Vector: Malicious image files spread via Facebook and LinkedIn social networks; Unsolicited file downloads or clicks on malformed image files in social media messages
Indicators of Compromise: Files with unusual double extensions such as .jpg.js, .jpg.hta; Automatic or user-initiated download of malformed image files from Facebook and LinkedIn
